AnchorHint.title: AnchorHint
AnchorHint.description: A cached rendering hint only — never identity (TRD §4.1).

Highlight.title: Highlight
Highlight.description: The `highlights` row (Schema.md), returned by the highlights endpoint.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: The `notes` row (Schema.md), returned by every notes endpoint.

NoteInput.title: NoteInput
NoteInput.description:
What a caller submits to create or update a note.

`frontmatter_id` is absent to create (Vault Writer assigns one) and
present to update — the id carried in the note's own YAML frontmatter,
never the file path (D4).

PaperInput.title: PaperInput
PaperInput.description:
What the caller submits to add a paper — from a search result or a
pasted link/id. A pure upload with no resolvable id is out of scope for
v1: `canonical_id_source` (Schema.md) has no "upload" value, so at least
one of doi/arxiv_id/openalex_id/s2_id is required.

ProviderCredentials.title: ProviderCredentials
ProviderCredentials.description: What the user submits to save and validate one provider.

ProviderInfo.title: ProviderInfo
ProviderInfo.description: What is ever read back — never ciphertext, nonce, or plaintext key.

QuoteAnchorInput.title: QuoteAnchorInput
QuoteAnchorInput.description:
The wire shape of `QuoteAnchor` in TRD §4.1 — what a caller submits
to be validated and anchored fresh (D24), same as an extractive card
field.

SourceIds.title: SourceIds
SourceIds.description: Whatever source ids a literature API returned for one paper.
